full_judgment: 17. Respondent No. 1 has further asserted that there is a mosque at plot No. 4, road No. 12 of Sector-9 but the petitioner has stated in the affidavit-in-reply that land is the waqf property of one Nawab Ali and his brother who made a gift of the same for graveyard-cum-mosque and it was never earmarked by the respondent No. 1 who could not show any paper showing that this plot No. 4 at Road No. 12 was earlier earmarked for mosque. Thus there is no evidence in support of the contention of the respondent No. 1 that because of the embankment and complication about the acquisition the civic facilities have been taken away and plots have been revised in number and size.
